items.headline: Why is the Iowa State Fair a political hub? Local professor explains
items.summary: Iowa's state fair has become a political hotspot, drawing candidates eager to connect with voters before the November elections.

items.headline: Iowa State Fair announces replacement act after Colt Ford injured in bus crash
items.summary: Sterling Elza will replace Colt Ford at the fair's free MidAmerican Energy Stage on Wednesday, Aug. 19.

items.headline: Centennial celebration: Family camps at Iowa State Fair for 100 years
items.summary: The Caves family is celebrating camping for the 100th year at the Iowa State Fairgrounds.

items.headline: Veterans Day at the Iowa State Fair: Veterans parade, military tributes and more
items.summary: John Derner, the executive director of the American Legion of Iowa, said Veterans Day is his favorite day of the fair, especially this year during America 250.

items.headline: Police: Search for man accused of shooting Muscatine officer continues
items.summary: Muscatine police provided new information Sunday evening on the search for a man accused of shooting an officer following a pursuit Friday.

items.headline: Suspect at large after officer shot in Muscatine
items.summary: Residents are urged not to approach Mark Lee Jackson. If he is seen, community members should call 911 immediately.

items.headline: Fresh Films debuts its first Quad Cities feature film at Alternating Currents
items.summary: Fresh Films debuted its first Quad Cities-made feature film during Alternating Currents, showcasing a production built with help from the local community.

items.headline: Gas leak reported on Olivia Drive in Geneseo; repairs expected to take several hours
items.summary: Nicor Gas crews are working to repair a gas leak on Olivia Drive in Geneseo, with repairs expected to continue for several hours.

items.headline: Iowa girl charged with 2nd-degree murder in death of Jefferson County child
items.summary: Officials say an investigation established probable cause to believe the death was neither accidental or self-inflicted, and that it appeared intentional.

items.headline: MLB at the Field of Dreams returns in 2027 with Royals vs. Red Sox
items.summary: The Kansas City Royals and Boston Red Sox will face off at the iconic Field of Dreams movie site in Dyersville, Iowa, on August 12, 2027
